title: Vegetable Lasagna
description: Layered lasagna with spinach, mushrooms, pizza sauce, a cottage cheese and egg mixture, and mozzarella, made in aluminum pans.

items.notes: not in original ingredient list; used in steps 2 and 6

steps.instruction: Step 1: Sautee sliced mushrooms and drain. Thaw chopped spinach. Combine cottage cheese, eggs and Italian spices. Mix Don Pepino Pizza Sauce, granulated garlic powder, olive oil, mushrooms and spinach in large container.

Step 3: Cover bottom of pan with 4 lasagna noodles. Cover noodles with 12 oz of pizza sauce mixture and 4 oz of cottage cheese mixture. Stir it gently and even it out. Sprinkle generously with mozzarella cheese.

Step 4: Repeat step 3 and firmly press down on lasagna noodles. Cover noodles with 12 oz of pizza sauce mixture and 4 oz of cottage cheese mixture. Stir it gently and even it out. Sprinkle generously with mozzarella cheese.
Step 5: Repeat step 3. Cover noodles with 12 oz of pizza sauce mixture and 4 oz of cottage cheese mixture. Stir it gently and even it out. Do not sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
Step 6: Spray with soy or canola oil and cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Place in 375 Deg F oven for 1 1/2 hours or until noodles are soft. Use thermometer or long tooth picks. Internal temp should be greater than 160 Deg F.
Remove from oven. Remove aluminum foil.
Sprinkle generously with mozzarella cheese, put back in oven and brown. Will take 10 to 20 minutes.

notes: Transcription note: The 12 10 x 13 inch aluminum pans are printed in the original ingredient list and kept there as equipment.
